-- 创建表语句
CREATE TABLE `instrument_data` (
    `id` INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    `use_department` VARCHAR(255),
    `station_name` FLOAT,
    `instrument_name` VARCHAR(255),
    `usage_location` VARCHAR(255),
    `installation_position` VARCHAR(255),
    `model_spec` VARCHAR(255),
    `measurement_range` VARCHAR(255),
    `accuracy_level` VARCHAR(255),
    `manufacturer` VARCHAR(255),
    `factory_number` VARCHAR(255),
    `verification_type` VARCHAR(255),
    `compulsory_scope` FLOAT,
    `compulsory_scope_detail` FLOAT,
    `usage_type` VARCHAR(255),
    `trade_instrument_type` FLOAT,
    `measurement_medium` VARCHAR(255),
    `status` VARCHAR(255),
    `management_type` VARCHAR(255),
    `verification_agency` VARCHAR(255),
    `expiration_date` DATE,
    `verification_date` DATE,
    `remark` FLOAT
);
